== Blanking date source precision (18 November 2026) ==
The former exact 22 July 2024 blanking day came from the kit month and parent Set 23 release, not an exact day in Imperial Detention’s source record. The PC’s front.errataDate 15 July 2023 describes its earlier added sentence; the same notes separately say “July 2024:Blanked.” The complete Rules Advocate post 1427114, timestamp 24July 2024 05:03:49 UTC, explicitly names this card as blanked but does not state an earlier effective day. Blanked therefore uses the source-qualified bound “by 24July 2024”. This does not assert that 24July was the first blanking day and does not import the Set 23 release date.
